comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily a rural Alaska electric utility; telecom is secondary, so the business mix and economics differ from a fiber broadband operator.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mix of mobile wireless and international Caribbean operations plus government-funded builds; differs from a US regional fiber and cable broadband operator.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; broadband is only a small segment.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Integrated broadband, cable video, voice, business data and wholesale fiber operator owning its network; similar to Shentel, though Alaska-based and wireless-heavy.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: TDS Telecom runs fiber and cable broadband, video and voice in smaller US markets, closely matching Shentel's wireline business.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale carrier fiber transport, matching Shentel's fiber and carrier lines.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite operator and defense equipment manufacturer; different technology, customers and revenue model than terrestrial fiber broadband.
